newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat announces October temporary layoffs.
newsitem.headline: Fiat announces October temporary layoffs.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat Auto announced temporary layoffs from October 14 to 31 in order to reduce production by 9,400 vehicles.
Fiat had already announced it was reducing vehicle output during September and the first two weeks of October by 18,500 due to the continued weakness in the domestic car market.

A company spokesman said the new layoffs will involve workers at the Pomigliano plant producing the Alfa 145, 146 and 155, at Rivalta for the Lancia Delta, Dedra, K and Fiat Bravo, and Arese for the Alfa Gtv and Spider.
The layoffs will affect 15,400 workers in the period October 14-18, some 15,100 between October 21-25 and 8,500 for the October 28-31 period.
